paragraphs: He is mentioned in Kiddushin 59a: he went to betroth a woman for his son, and in the end betrothed her for himself.[^1]

notes.text: The actual Davidson Kiddushin 59a paragraph has Ravin Chasida seeking a betrothal for his son and then betrothing the woman for himself. That direction is retained. No surrounding justification, ethical ruling, or additional figure is imported into the notice.
